newsitem.title: INDIA: Israeli President Weizman arrives in India.
newsitem.headline: Israeli President Weizman arrives in India.

text.p: Israeli President Ezer Weizman arrived in New Delhi on Sunday on a week-long state visit, the Press Trust of India reported.

Weizmann, who served in India as a pilot for the British air force 50 years ago, will begin his official engagements on Monday after a ceremonial state welcome at the presidential palace, the news agency said.
Indian diplomats said last week that Weizman's visit would focus on more than 100 joint ventures, a majority of them in agriculture.

The visit by Weizman and an accompanying business delegation will mark a new high in ties between the two countries. India established diplomatic relations with Israel in 1992 after decades of Cold War suspicions linked to the Palestinian problem.
India and Israel are expected to sign four agreements during Weizmann's visit, including one on agriculture, as well as cultural and technical agreements, officials said.

Indian companies have shown a keen in interest in forming joint ventures with Israeli counterparts to make drip-irrigation equipment. Indian officials say Israel's water-conservation technology could be of immense use in India's dry zones.
